correctness.rationale: Disjoint supports give the exact three-halves Lebesgue norm scaling by N to the two-thirds power. Hölder and the three-dimensional Sobolev inequality bound the attractive form by that constant times the kinetic form. The stated coupling therefore makes the quadratic form nonnegative for every geometry. Standard relative form compactness of a finite compactly supported regular potential preserves essential spectrum [0,infinity), forcing spectral bottom zero. The endpoint and nonsharpness are stated explicitly.
